# Multi-Agent Systems {#sec-multi-agent}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_When does decomposing work among agents create useful parallelism rather than coordination overhead?_

## Planned Coverage

- Task decomposition and ownership boundaries
- Delegation, communication, and shared state
- Synchronization, consensus, and merge conflicts
- Redundancy, debate, and independent verification
- Deadlock, livelock, duplication, and emergent cost

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to decide whether a multi-agent architecture is justified and define the interfaces needed to coordinate it.
